description: The Mopo project deposits hourly country-level residual electricity demand for its European energy-system models. The provider says it first estimated total country demand, then removed electricity for heating and industrial consumption because those sectors are handled by other component models. Zenodo lists a public 127 MB ZIP under CC BY 4.0. A modeller could use the residual series with separately modelled heat and industry demand to avoid double counting in capacity or dispatch scenarios. It is a modelled decomposition, not a direct observation of a separately metered consumer category. The own page does not state the weather or calendar years, countries, units, load-fitting method or treatment of electrified transport. Those gaps limit standalone interpretation and must be resolved before use. The ZIP was not downloaded, so the country columns and series lengths remain unverified. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this residual-demand package.
